description.purpose: Fan-in collector (examples/14b-tool-loop-store protocol): persists assistant tool_call turns and tool results as thread rows in the memory store, and fires the rebuilt cumulative thread back to the planner exactly once per completed iteration (RMW + atomic fired-flag guard).
description.use_when: Between the tool cells and the loop llm whenever parallel tool_calls must fan in before re-entry.
description.not_in_scope: No content transformation; thread state lives in the store (code cells own no script-visible state).
description.emits_meaning: route cstore/cguard: store ops (insert/select/update) to the memory cell. route fire: the rebuilt thread messages[] for the planner re-entry. Incomplete rounds and lost guard races emit NOTHING (empty multi-send array — terminal by design).
description.consumes_meaning: c_asst lane: dispatch's assistant turn (tool_call list). c_res lane: one tool_result per tool invocation. store replies: insert/select/update results keyed by context.store_origin=='collector'. context.turn_id/iter correlate the round.
examples: 3 parallel web_search calls -> 1 assistant row + 3 tool rows -> is_complete -> guard update wins once -> fire thread (7 turns) to planner with iter+1
